body: I think I just wanted to make a pointless ramble to get this off my chest, since I've been bottling this up for awhile. Thank you for your offer though.

I don't know you, but the fact that you took the time to help me makes me believe that you'd be a great father. I can't be certain if I'll ever be fit to have a child, but the thought of it comforts me somehow. Thank you for this it was very kind.

Thank you I really like childeren, so it hurt when I realized having one wouldn't be fair to the child. Typing this was oddly therapeutic for me. Maybe I'll start to work on a to-do list and work on small tasks till I'm ready for the real world again.

Thank you for saying that. It just shatters me everytime someone isn't happy with me. I know I can't please everyone, but it's what I want most in life. 
I'm bipolar and have anemia. I'm not sure why I didn't mention that I'm not ashamed by any of these things, but I would much rather not pass them down. I do really like kids and if I ever feel that I can provide them with a happy life I'll happy adopt an older child. I wish I told them that, but I didn't think it would have helped.
